risks.risk: Engine model/engine code is not readable, so the exact fitment (and therefore the correct market price) is unknown.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up photo of the engine code/label (e.g., stamped code on block/head) and the full engine bay tag/plate.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used engine assembly with unknown code/fitment (worst-case for buyer: may not match your car).

risks.risk: “Tested and working / no knock” cannot be verified from a still photo; internal faults may exist.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of the engine starting and idling (cold start if possible) plus a brief rev test, or a diagnostic scan showing no stored misfire/knock codes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: treat as needs inspection/possible faults).

risks.risk: Mileage and “never opened” are not verifiable remotely; could be high mileage or previously repaired/opened.
risks.proof: Ask for photos of tamper seals (head cover/ECU seals) and a screenshot/photo of ECU mileage or service record if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown mileage and not guaranteed “never opened.”

risks.risk: Possible missing parts/accessories (alternator, sensors, coils, brackets) or incomplete harnesses not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: Ask for a checklist photo: all accessories laid out and labeled, and a photo of the engine with all connectors/sensors installed.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially incomplete/needs parts to complete installation.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the engine code/label stamped on the block/head (the code that determines exact engine variant).
Video of the engine starting and idling (and ideally a short rev) to support “tested and working / no knock.”
Photos of tamper seals and any evidence supporting “never opened,” plus any mileage proof (ECU/service record).
Photos showing all sensors/connectors/accessories included (and a quick inventory list).
response.reason: The photo shows an engine assembly, but the exact engine code/variant and any proof of testing are not readable/visible. Without that, a worst-case price from comparables would be guesswork.
